notes: Read-only capture on a healthy running disk_usage service. CPU/RSS via tools/sample_resource.sh (--match disk_usage/main.py, 60 samples, label running_baseline). SLO via tools/probe_http.sh on GET /disk/usage?depth=1 (--repeats 8); full-depth du / is heavy (~5.5s) so depth=1 limits du work. Single GET /disk/speed at size_bytes=1048576 (1 MiB minimum). DELETE /disk/paths not exercised (destructive). Raw evidence: /tmp/disk_usage_sample.json, /tmp/disk_usage_slo.json, /tmp/disk_speed_response.txt.

route_inventory.note: Confirmed routes on live Pi; DELETE not exercised in this capture.

running_baseline.note: GET contracts on a healthy running disk_usage (idle, no concurrent benchmarks).

slo_running_baseline.note: GET /disk/usage?depth=1 only; default depth runs du / and is ~5.5s per request — not suitable for high repeat counts.

transitions.note: Single-shot speed benchmark (reversible: temp file written then deleted). Not looped.

speed_test_single.effect: disktest write+verify at 1 MiB; returns write_speed_mbps, read_speed_mbps, bytes_tested, seed

settings_mutations.note: disk_usage has no settings manager or settings.json persistence (verified: no settings imports in main.py)

platform_matrix.note: disk_usage behavior is platform-independent (local du/disktest on root filesystem); not captured across boards. Runtime captured on Navigator only.

state_machine: none — disk_usage has no service-level lifecycle state machine; usage inspection and speed tests are stateless request handlers (see service_definition states: Unknown)
